title: This Game Sold 1,000,000 Copies And Still Died

scenes.text: This game sold a million copies.
The studio was bankrupt 90 days later.
In 2010, Rhode Island guaranteed a loan.
To a first-time studio run by a retired baseball pitcher.
Kingdoms of Amalur launched in February 2012.
Reviews were warm. It sold over a million copies.
It needed three million just to break even.
May 2012: payroll missed. Entire staff laid off.
The game didn't fail. The math did.
